scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && rm -rf backend/public/app && mkdir -p backend/public/app && cp -R frontend/dist/. backend/public/app/
scripts.service:start: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env
scripts.service:restart: npm run build && pm2 restart aurora --update-env
scripts.qa:smoke: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend test
